notes: Hard small-scale ML harness bundling four strands that must all hold: (1) train 300-dim word2vec-style embeddings on a token corpus via a reusable script interface the harness re-runs on a fresh corpus, and reach a cosine-Spearman STS cut-off > 0.70 plus topic-aware nearest neighbours; (2) train a value-iteration RL policy on a discrete grid environment with boundary clipping and an inclusive-euclidean-radius goal reward, clearing a mean-return threshold across trials and satisfying step edge cases; (3) run subsampling-stability (prediction-strength) clustering that returns the correct optimal k on fresh point sets; (4) keep a deterministic, tokenizable corpus/STS contract. Difficulty is hard because most claimed competencies carry hard floors; it comes from dependent multi-stage reasoning (the embedding artifact feeds both neighbour and STS checks; the script must generalise when re-run on hidden inputs), strict quantitative tolerances (exact 300-dim, spearman threshold, optimal-k and reward thresholds), and hidden-case generalisation across a new corpus, a new environment config, and new cluster datasets.
